items.evidence: Loop aspirates 18 uL from mm_res A1 and dispenses into each of the 96 pcr_plate wells with p20 and one tip; end_state:pcr_plate passes.
Steps 2 and 3 pair colony_plate and primer_plate wells to pcr_plate wells in order, 1 uL each with p20, with a 3x mix after the colony dispense; end-state checks pass.
pick_up and drop_tip occur inside each per-well loop in steps 2 and 3; the single tip in step 1 only touches empty wells; no_cross_contamination passes.
Step 4 protocol.comment records sealing and 98C 30 s; 30x[98C 10 s, 60C 30 s, 72C 30 s]; 72C 2 min; 4C hold.
The protocol follows the task steps and quantities with accurate metadata and comments, and has no invented steps; the labware labels are correct.

judge.summary: The protocol meets the task: 18 µL master mix into all 96 wells, 1 µL colony template with a 3x mix, and 1 µL primer pair, all with p20 and a fresh tip per sample. It records the thermocycling comment, and all measured checks passed.
